Class ReplicationSettingsSelector

public inherited sharing class ReplicationSettingsSelector

Selector class for querying ReplicationSettings__mdt custom metadata records. Provides methods to retrieve field mapping configuration and event-based replication settings with their associated field mappings from FieldMapping__mdt child records.

Methods

public static ReplicationSettingsSelector.Result get(String settingsName)

Retrieves a single ReplicationSettings__mdt record by developer name with all associated field mappings. Returns parent-child relationship configuration, field mappings, validation formulas, and additional data. Only returns active settings with active field mappings.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record to retrieve

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing the metadata record with nested FieldMapping__mdt records

public static ReplicationSettingsSelector.Result getForEvent(String eventName)

Retrieves all ReplicationSettings__mdt records configured for a specific event. Uses LIKE query to find all settings where the Events__c field contains the specified event name. Returns developer name and post-processing methods for each matching configuration. Only returns active settings.

Parameters:
    eventName – String: The event name to search for in the Events__c field

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing all matching metadata records with their post-processing configuration
